*Per ally whose name includes "Cell" (Cellza and Cell Max excluded)
on the team*
- ATK & DEF 150%{passiveImg:up_g} (up to 750%)
- Damage reduction rate & chance of evading enemy's attack 10%{passiveImg:up_g}
(up to 50%)
*Per ally whose name includes "Cell Jr." on the team*
- Ki +1 and ATK & DEF 5%{passiveImg:up_g} for 2 turns for "Cell (Perfect Form)"
or "Perfect Cell" when attacking
*For 1 turn from the character's entry turn, or when there are 2 or less
TEQ Type allies attacking in the same turn*
- ATK & DEF 250%{passiveImg:up_g} when attacking
- Launches an additional Super Attack

- {passiveImg:once}{passiveImg:forever}Ki +2

- {passiveImg:once}{passiveImg:forever}Chance of evading enemy's attack 20%{passiveImg:up_g}

a critical hit 15%{passiveImg:up_g} for 3 turns
